title: EmDash: with Name left blank the description is still written and a Vietnamese site translated; a brochure button never leads to a contact page the customer unticked
steps: From packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-business run: node --test --test-reporter=tap tests/personalize-tone.test.mjs tests/personalize-fallback-gate.test.mjs tests/personalize-demo-files-seed.test.mjs
Read the ok/not ok line of each test named in run.tests, and the fail count.
expect: 'a description with no name is written: the copy prompt carries the business and no name' is ok.

'the gate: a step that writes needs the description, a translation needs a root written in another language' is ok: modelMay('copy', 'en', {about}, {}) is true with no name, modelMay('labels', 'en', {}, {en: 'vi'}) is true.
'FULL with the contact page unticked: the brochure button goes, never to a closed page' is ok: hero_cta2_url and hero_cta2_label are both '' (was '/contact').
'FULL in Vietnamese with the seed as released: the brochure button leads to the contact page' stays ok (/contact when the page is kept).
Every other test of the three files stays ok.

selectors.contact: planFrom option closed, step 4 (DEMO FILE LINKS) in tools/personalize.mjs

evidence: Local stand 13/10/2026 (tasks/evidence/site-questions-2026-10-13/): Tracy Business EmDash, Name blank with About given, kept the demo copy word for word; a Vietnamese bakery with only Home ticked had the hero's 'Liên hệ tiệm bánh' leading to /contact, which answered 404 (shots/local-h1/tracy-business-emdash-onlyhome-home.jpg).
fence: The real tool against the template's real seed and a mock EmDash, with a scripted model. Not exercised: a served release (1.7.17 is built locally; the switch is the release step).
